description.zh-CN: 基于 MaaFramework 的异环全能小助手，用屏幕识别实现日常任务、自动采集、副本挂机与抽卡记录，无注入。
description.en-US: All-in-one Neverness to Everness assistant built on MaaFramework, automating dailies, farming, dungeons and gacha tracking via screen recognition without injection.

description.zh-CN: 基于 ok-script 框架的异环图像识别自动化工具，支持后台副本挂机与丰富的插件生态，无内存注入。
description.en-US: Image-recognition automation for Neverness to Everness built on the ok-script framework, supporting background dungeon grinding and a rich plugin ecosystem without injection.

description.zh-CN: 面向异环的「更好」自动化框架与桌面客户端，基于 Rust/Tauri，追求更稳定、更快的自动化体验。
description.en-US: Alternative automation framework and desktop client for Neverness to Everness built with Rust/Tauri, aiming for better performance and stability.

description.zh-CN: 塔吉多社区每日签到插件（GSUID 生态），支持幻塔与异环。
description.en-US: Taygedo daily check-in plugin for the GSUID ecosystem, supporting Tower of Fantasy and Neverness to Everness.

description.zh-CN: 塔吉多自动签到工具，支持多账号、自动重登、APP/游戏签到与异环云时长，可部署到 GitHub Actions、Cloudflare Workers 或 Docker。
description.en-US: Taygedo auto check-in with multi-account support, auto-relogin, app/game check-in and NTE cloud time, deployable via GitHub Actions, Cloudflare Workers or Docker.

description.zh-CN: 异环「驱动」养成计算器，帮助全角色轻松规划养成路线与搭配。
description.en-US: Cultivation (drive) calculator for Neverness to Everness, helping plan character progression and loadouts.

description.zh-CN: 异环全能养成与伤害计算器，OCR 快速扫描、配装推荐、详细伤害与材料计算，公式参数可调。
description.en-US: All-in-one progression and damage calculator for NTE with fast OCR scanning, gear recommendations, detailed damage and material math with tunable formulas.

description.zh-CN: 异环抽卡模拟器，用于试验与规划抽取策略。
description.en-US: Gacha (warp) simulator for Neverness to Everness for testing and planning pulls.

description.zh-CN: 开源 NTE DPS 工具包，用于伤害分析、测试与性能优化等研究工作流。
description.en-US: Open-source NTE DPS toolkit for damage analytics, testing and performance-optimization workflows.

description.zh-CN: 实时 DPS 悬浮窗，通过被动抓包（无内存注入）统计伤害，含队伍追踪与社区排行。
description.en-US: Real-time DPS overlay using passive packet capture (no memory injection), with party tracking and community rankings.

description.zh-CN: 异环抽卡记录分析与导出工具，支持多个卡池，输出可追踪的 JSON。
description.en-US: Gacha history analysis and export tool for NTE, supporting multiple banners and tracker-ready JSON output.

description.zh-CN: 基于 Wireshark 的异环流量研究与逆向分析，记录服务器、域名、TLS 与协议行为。
description.en-US: Wireshark-based traffic analysis and reverse-engineering research, documenting NTE servers, domains, TLS and protocol behavior.

description.zh-CN: 异环游戏资源提取合集，包含 UI、数据表与文本等素材。
description.en-US: Extracted Neverness to Everness game assets, including UI textures, data tables and localization text.

description.zh-CN: 异环模型导入器，用于将游戏模型导入 Blender 等工具进行查看与修改。
description.en-US: Model importer for Neverness to Everness, bringing in-game models into Blender and other tools.

description.zh-CN: 面向二次元游戏的轻量 Mod 管理器与发布平台，使用 Rust/Slint 构建，支持异环。
description.en-US: Lightweight mod manager and publishing platform for anime games built with Rust/Slint, with Neverness to Everness support.

description.zh-CN: 为异环 BAGEL 系统替换自定义图片/照片背景的工具，支持国服与国际服。
description.en-US: Custom image replacement tool for NTE's BAGEL photo system, supporting CN and international servers.

description.zh-CN: 异环配置文件合集，用于优化画面效果或性能表现。
description.en-US: Collection of NTE configuration files to improve visuals or performance.

description.zh-CN: 异环插件框架与 API，支持第三方为游戏开发插件与扩展。
description.en-US: Plugin framework and API for Neverness to Everness, enabling third-party plugin and extension development.

description.zh-CN: 异环机器人插件，支持 OneBot、QQ、微信、KOOK、Telegram、Discord 等平台接入。
description.en-US: NTE chatbot plugin supporting OneBot, QQ, WeChat, KOOK, Telegram, Discord and more.

description.zh-CN: 异环互动地图，含传送点、收集品、任务、朝圣点与采集路线，支持进度追踪。
description.en-US: Interactive NTE map with teleport points, collectibles, quests, pilgrimage spots, farming routes and progress tracking.

description.zh-CN: 异环全能小工具，含全服抽卡分析、游玩时长记录与车载音乐功能，支持国服/国际服。
description.en-US: NTE utility with full-server gacha analysis, play-time tracking and in-car music, for CN & international servers.

description.zh-CN: 异环官服/B 服切换器，用于在国服官方服务器与 B 服之间切换。
description.en-US: Server switcher between the official CN server and the Bilibili server for NTE.

description.zh-CN: 用 Python 还原的异环车载悬浮音乐播放器。
description.en-US: Python recreation of NTE's in-car floating music player.

description.zh-CN: 多款抽卡游戏（含异环）的综合数据库与工具集合，基于 Next.js。
description.en-US: Comprehensive database and tool collection for gacha games including NTE, built with Next.js.

description.zh-CN: Blender 插件，为抽卡游戏（含异环）模型提供自动绑定、卡通着色与材质管线。
description.en-US: Blender add-on providing automated rigging, toon shaders and material pipelines for gacha models including NTE.

description.zh-CN: 多功能 MIDI 转按键播放器，用于异环等游戏内的乐器弹奏，基于 C#/WPF。
description.en-US: Feature-rich MIDI-to-keyboard player for in-game instruments across multiple games including NTE, built with C#/WPF.
